2 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Add a crash-safe cross-platform concurrent-build mutex (proper-lockfile): never age-steal a live long-running build, race-free reclaim of a dead holder -- the build currently has no lock + Make the build skip decision content-bound via the existing verifyBuildBinding (not mtime/existence) and add an analogous packages/utils binding -- applied to the three build call sites are performed simultaneously?)

understanding still has 2 undigested unknowns: DEV-time detail: exact proper-lockfile stale/update interval config (stale>=30s, update<stale/2) to guarantee a live holder is never age-stolen.; DEV-time detail: the shape of the packages/utils build-binding manifest and where its sourceDigest incorporates the packages/main/dist it links against.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation
